bsp.otherwise: no BSP; NaN, Infinity and a missing value count as none; reads before CLOSED, and corrections after it, are logged and never used
valid_if: our runner WINNER or LOSER in it
bsp.value: actualSP from the first raw read that shows the market CLOSED

caps.config_names: orders.caps.<name without its unit suffix>, and orders.rules.external_exposure_tolerance; the config writes money in pounds and max_book_age_s in seconds

placing_ends_at_first_of: N reached: the first 400 eligible bets in decision order are final, and so is every earlier PLACE record
any breach of RS-19: a bet it does not allow, a session Yu did not start, or a money number changed without Yu
Yu ending the pilot in writing

final_execution.after_final: later reads and corrections (C, L, CLOSED or BSP) are logged and never change a final record
final_execution.agreement: exact: sizes and prices as written in the raw JSON, parsed with Decimal (never through float); they agree only if exactly equal, with no rounding; PT1 and PT4 cannot choose a tolerance
final_execution.canonical_observation: the earliest qualifying observation by durable capture sequence in the journal, never by loading order; for C the earliest read showing EXECUTION_COMPLETE; for L the earliest logged row, usable from the PT receipt; later observations are logged as corrections and never replace it
final_execution.consistency_check: the final matched size is at least the place report's, and matched + cancelled + lapsed + voided size equals 200p, the four sizes from C when C is read; a failure makes the size unresolved and sets a review stop
final_execution.removal_first: a bet already classed void or post_decision_removal is not price-compared

sources.C: listCurrentOrders once the bet is EXECUTION_COMPLETE, read before its market settles; sizeMatched and averagePriceMatched at full precision
sources.L: listClearedOrders after Betfair settles; sizeSettled, priceMatched and priceReduced; counts as read only once a PT1 or PT4 receipt has verified those fields against the website

table.read_by_deadline: C and L: sizes and prices exactly equal, priceReduced false

table.final_when: at the deadline; pending until then

table.final_size_and_P: L's sizeSettled and priceMatched if priceReduced is false; else measurement_unresolved

inference.G: the number of dates with at least one sample bet
inference.cluster: the UTC date of the decision time
inference.critical_value: the 97.5% point of Student's t with G - 1 degrees of freedom
inference.limitation: CR1 with t(G-1) is a common minimum correction; it does not give exact coverage with few clusters (Cameron and Miller 2015, section VI)
inference.standard_error: CR1: SE^2 = G/(G-1) * sum_g [sum_{i in g} (x_i - m)]^2 / N^2

S_requires: Yu's typed settle-market for the market succeeded
the final execution record is resolved
the CLOSED read shows one WINNER, our runner WINNER or LOSER, no void and no runner removed after the decision
Betfair's per-bet profit is present and the commission check passed
ledger.S_winner: gross = final matched size x (P - 1), P at full precision, floored to the penny; commission = commission_rate x the positive market gross, rounded up to the penny; net = gross - commission; the value is the lower of our net and Betfair's per-bet profit minus that commission
ledger.W: minus the final matched stake if the final execution record gives it; before that record is final, minus the matched size of the canonical C read showing EXECUTION_COMPLETE, unless a consistency check has failed for that record; otherwise -200p. A bet that never matched counts 0p from its EXECUTION_COMPLETE read; a resolved zero match is 0p, including a record with no submit event or FAILED(transport_not_sent)
always_w: any runner removed after the decision
an unknown result, price or size
any settlement that cannot be verified
ledger.equity: the sum of one value per PLACE record, each in exactly one part: W (worst case, the default) or S (settled and verified)
ledger.over_tolerance: the bet stays in W and a review stop is set, from the first bet, PT4 included

definitions.measurement_unresolved: the final matched size, or a matched bet's price, is unresolved
definitions.post_decision_removal: another runner ACTIVE in the decision book was later removed (seen in the CLOSED read or in L), whether or not a reduction factor changed our price; decided before any price comparison
definitions.protocol_violation: it broke RS-19 or this contract
definitions.void: the market was voided, or our runner was removed

measurement_classes.final_when: the execution record is final and the BSP rule has decided, and at off + 7 days at the latest; anything still unknown then is measurement_unresolved; later reads never change a final class
measurement_classes.rule: Each PLACE record ends in exactly one class; the first that applies wins. Only eligible bets enter the primary; every other class is an exclusion, counted and reported.

metric.P: the final execution record's price: L's priceMatched when C and L agree exactly, else that of the one source used
metric.estimand: mean NCLV over eligible bets; conditional on filling
metric.name: NCLV
metric.partial_fills: eligible and unweighted; NCLV depends on the price, not the size
metric.reading: A positive mean is a commission-adjusted price advantage over BSP, assuming 1/BSP is a calibrated win probability for this population. It is not proof of positive expected profit.

pause.at_level: a PLACE whose -200p would take equity to or below a level not yet acknowledged becomes SKIP(pause); a ledger change that leaves equity at or below such a level has the same effect at once; either way a session stop and a review stop are journaled at once
pause.basis: equity, the one ledger equation, counted from the first registration and measured from 0p, never from a peak; equity and the acknowledged levels carry over to a new registration or a replacement contract and are never reset
pause.levels: every multiple of -15000p: -15000p, -30000p, -45000p and so on; they never move
pause.to_continue: Yu looks, then types PILOT ACK naming the level; an ACK acknowledges that one level for the contract's whole life, and the next level stays armed; an acknowledged level never fires again

placement_limits.counts: PLACE records, not R6's submitted instructions; a PLACE takes its lifetime slot and day slot in its own append; a slot whose request was definitely not sent stays used
placement_limits.reservations: every reservation uses up its market, SKIP included; no reservation is ever released

at_the_end_never_deciding: the stake-weighted mean over the primary bets (s_i = final matched size) and the count of every class
the decision-price series: NCLV at the decision price for every PLACE record in the same decision range, sent or not, filled or not, with its own exclusions (void, post-decision removal, missing BSP)
raw CLV by price band and country
profit after commission and the running total, as plain tables
reporting.data_lock: the analysis waits until every PLACE record made before placing ended has its final class, or has passed off + 7 days; then it runs once, on the Air, in the terminal, and Astra recomputes it independently there; no earlier efficacy figure and no provisional PASS
reporting.interim: operational counts and codes only, in the terminal: reservations; decisions; SKIPs by code; PLACE records; sends; refusals by rule; fills (full, partial, none); cancels; UNKNOWNs; settles; classes still pending; missing BSP; stops; sessions; no NCLV, profit, price-band or calibration figure
reporting.private_risk_view: Yu only, on the Air: balance, exposure, the ledger and the pause levels; never copied into Git or agent reports; it changes nothing in the analysis
reporting.publication: nothing enters Git or reports/ unless Yu approves the exact fields and a test checks their projection
reporting.unplanned_looks: logged; they cannot change the rule, inclusion, N or the threshold

rule.evidence: After the reservation, one fresh, uncached live-key listMarketCatalogue row with the MARKET_DESCRIPTION, EVENT_TYPE, MARKET_START_TIME and EVENT projections, then one decision book with isMarketDataDelayed false; no second fetch; a caller-supplied book, catalogue or country is refused

market.country_source: event.countryCode in the fresh catalogue row

rule.off: marketStartTime in the fresh catalogue row; the event's openDate is never the off

order.limit_price: exactly the decision book's best back price; nothing is snapped

rule.remainder: whole cancel of the unmatched remainder of the pilot order, straight after the place report (during a KILL, engineering note section 8 says when)

selection.runner: the only ACTIVE runner with the lowest best back price

rule.send_book: V0-V14 and V9b as today, and V13 (no more than 2 ticks of movement); the selection is still ACTIVE; refused if the send book's market_time differs from the record's off; never re-decides
rule.summary: Back the clear favourite in a GB or IE horse-racing WIN market with at least 5 runners, about five minutes before the off, at its best back price, 200p flat, when that price is 1.50 to 4.00 and the book is deep and tight. Any unmatched part is cancelled at once. No retry, re-entry, lay or second runner.

window.text: the decision book was observed from off - 300 s to off - 300 s + 15 s

sample.analysis_population: if N is reached, the PLACE records up to and including the 400th eligible one; otherwise every PLACE record; PT4 records reported apart are in neither
sample.decision_order: the journal sequence of each PLACE record's reservation; it never changes
sample.late_completion: a PLACE record made before placing ended may still complete N if it is final by the data lock
sample.primary: the first 400 eligible bets in decision order; a bet counts only once every earlier PLACE record has its final class; placing stops there

pt4.covers: the PLACE records of every PT4 session, if PT4 repeats
pt4.joins_sample_if: the first session after the PT4 receipt runs under PT4's registration receipt
pt4.otherwise: reported apart; they still use their slots, and the sample starts after them

sample.surplus: PLACE records after the 400th eligible one, in decision order: finalised, counted and reported, outside the primary and the validity gates

units: Money in integer pence (_p), prices in integer hundredths (_h), durations in the unit their key names; rates and shares are decimal strings, read with Decimal.

validity_gates.checked: once, at the data lock, on the analysis population; they never end placing early

fill_rate.definition: bets with final matched size above 0 / sent bets whose final matched size is resolved

measurement_unresolved_share.definition: measurement_unresolved / sent bets (every PLACE record except definitely_unsent)

validity_gates.zero_denominator: there is no eligible bet: the gate is not evaluated, and the result is INCONCLUSIVE: insufficient_eligible_sample unless INVALID applies

verdict.ending_before_n: an ending at the lifetime cap, at the final date or by Yu in writing gives INCONCLUSIVE: insufficient_eligible_sample unless INVALID applies; an ending for a breach of RS-19 is a protocol violation and gives INVALID; never an early PASS or a smaller-N test; the cap is never raised to rescue completion
order: INVALID: a failed validity gate or a protocol violation
INCONCLUSIVE: insufficient_eligible_sample, when fewer than 400 eligible bets exist at the data lock
